headline: Executive order setting further rules for carrying out the Presidential Records Act, which governs access to past presidents' records.
what_it_does: This order sets out additional steps for how the government carries out the Presidential Records Act. That law controls how records from a president's time in office are kept and when the public can see them. No summary was provided, so the specific rules in the order cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets procedures they follow when records from their time in office are considered for release.
The order likely shapes how the agency handles and releases presidential records.
The order may affect how and when they can get access to past presidents' records.
